issues.rule: MDC-026 / MDC-045 unknown is not zero
issues.detail: Rows coerce null activeDayShare and averageDistancePerActiveDayM to zero at lines 70 and 78. With a short observed window, unobserved weekdays become measured 0%/0 distance in plots, fallback tables and exported rows.
issues.fix: Retain null for unavailable weekday operands and render a localized unavailable value in fallback tables/export; preserve genuine observed zero active rate. Do not invent measurements.

issues.detail: Only costPerKwh/formatCurrency are read from useFormatting, ignoring available pricingState. Summary status and header query reflect drives alone (:105,115); retained settings refresh errors can leave a stale rate behind a Source returned label.
issues.fix: Consume existing pricingState and provide cost-specific loading/unavailable/stale notice and retry, retaining unrelated drive metrics and existing null-rate behavior.

issues.detail: Main utilization brief uses drivesState.status without the history-cap guard. Coverage brief separately maps an ok capped source to partial in UtilizationMethodology.tsx:202. Top metrics can therefore describe a capped response as Source returned without immediate partial context.
issues.fix: Propagate the existing cap disclosure into the summary source trust/scope while retaining returned rows, capped calculation behavior and all coverage details.

issues.detail: Distance per observed day is calculated from initialized distanceM even when no eligible rows have usable distance. Driving share similarly uses initialized duration totals (:832-835). TimeCostOverview.tsx:219 renders the distance total unconditionally for eligible rows. An eligible drive with missing distance/duration can appear as zero utilization rather than unavailable; field accounting exists but does not guard these aggregates.
issues.fix: Keep existing accounting and rollup formulas, but expose operand availability and guard summary/chart/panel displays when usable field count is zero; disclose partial field coverage without treating missing observations as zero.

visualIssues.detail: The below-cap informational disclosure always uses an amber-tinted surface. Fixed cyan-300 decorative icons also recur (:169,327; TimeCostOverview.tsx:155,240; BusiestDays.tsx:56) instead of theme-neutral metadata tokens.
visualIssues.fix: Use neutral semantic tokens for routine source metadata and decorative icons; reserve amber for actual capped/limited evidence. Keep saved chart palette and all warnings unchanged.

architectureIssues.detail: Registered workspace page passes start/end calendar strings to useDrives (:54-57) and to a UTC-only parser (:67-68; lib/utilization.ts:243-263). Shared useRangeState.ts:656-669 provides rolling instants and timezone-aware exclusive bounds. Thus Live/24h and non-UTC calendar scope cannot retain header semantics. Frozen asOfMs (:48) also clips later refreshes to page-mount time.
architectureIssues.fix: Coordinate page and utilization model to accept the existing startInstant/endInstantExclusive contract, preserve explicit calendar labels and observed-window calculations, and deliberately reconcile frozen analysis semantics with rolling scope. No second picker, legacy adapter, fake data or backend capability invention.

order: Restore precise workspace range equivalence in query and analytical model.
Preserve unknown/partial field measurements and independent pricing trust.

Reduce non-semantic fixed accents; keep existing architecture and every section.

competingImplementations.detail: Barrel exports an alternate KPI renderer using preformatted metricId text operands (:70-84), while mounted page uses VehicleEvidenceBrief with numeric measurements. This component is not mounted by this page; no claim about consumers outside scope.
competingImplementations.fix: Do not migrate the mounted page back to this alternate renderer. Resolve external callers before any later consolidation; preserve current numeric source bridge and IDs.
